public_rationale: The original BIG-bench paper explicitly reports the pattern Marcus describes. His use of wall names the measures that did not improve in those experiments. The evidence supports that historical description, while leaving future scalability open.
limitations: The finding applies to the evaluated models, scales and metrics.
Some metrics can conceal gradual progress.
This assessment does not establish an unavoidable or permanent wall.

our_interpretation: The paper is the original June 2022 BIG-bench report.
Progress means improvement in the reported task metrics across evaluated model sizes.
Marcus explicitly labels the non-improving measures the wall. In this sentence, that label does not independently establish that they can never improve.
criteria.support_condition: The original paper evaluates many tasks and reports improving scores on some while other scores remain flat over the tested scales.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The original paper does not report that pattern, or every evaluated task measure improves with scale.
